_about: Frame labels for the Madden NFL 27 local scorebug reader. One row per 1 fps sample (frame NNN taken at about NNN-0.56 s) of the HDMI clips on the build box (640x360), plus two 640x360 stills. Labelled by eye by Grok Bot on 2026-10-07/08 CT from enlarged crops; NOT owner-verified. left/right = score digits as drawn left/right on the strip (null = no readable score on this frame: the reader must blank). quarter/clock only where the standard strip's clock box is fully visible; clock '?' = could not be verified (skipped). train=false = used for eval only. skin: madden_standard | madden_dark | cfb | none.
